fact: FAREI, the government agricultural research and extension institute, has taken part in the UNCTAD CropWatch-ICP since 2021, uses the CropWatch mobile app for field monitoring of selected local crops, hosted a regional training in August 2023, and planned a staff training on satellite crop monitoring for 18-19 September 2025.
title: Concept note: National training workshop for Satellite-based crop monitoring using the CropWatch system
publisher: UNCTAD, with FAREI, AIRCAS and ANSO
